canon_ref.note: Rags explores the mountain: rival factions, a guarded armoury and a strict pecking order. Ulvama's offer comes with advice Rags finds vile; Rags kicks her. Tremborag then mocks Rags as a Goblin with a fake name.

b4.ulvama_mocks_rags_name.summary: Tremborag's chief [Shaman] Ulvama offers Rags an alliance but says a name given by a Human is no proper Goblin name. Rags kicks her, and soon the Great Chieftain himself is mocking Rags for her fake name.

canon_ref.note: The walled town is not named. Tremborag hid that its defenders included Gold-rank adventurers; two of them are killed (implied, not shown as confirmed). Garen kills one of Tremborag's Hobs during the stay.

b4.tremborag_raids_a_human_town.summary: Rags plans Tremborag's raid on a walled Human town, then learns he hid that Gold-rank adventurers guard it. In battle the Great Chieftain swells into a huge, monstrous form and tears through them. The town falls.

canon_ref.note: He fells a Hob with lightning in the breakout (3.29G); the text does not say the Hob died.

b4.noears_warns_rags.summary: The earless Goblin everyone treats as a fool drops the act: he is a real [Mage]. He tells Rags to keep her head down in Tremborag's mountain if she wants to live.

canon_ref.note: On the fourth night. Pyrite once lived in the mountain and sits with one captive only to protect her. He refuses Rags' power play and says he will leave.

b4.rags_names_pyrite_and_calls_a_revolt.summary: The Gold Stone Chieftain refuses to play Rags' power games and says he will leave the mountain. Rags gives him a name, Pyrite. Then, in the Redfang mess hall, she declares she is Goblin and asks who will follow her.
